description: Gotham G3 fixture F10 (agent modality — journey narration over cross-camera fusion). Reuses the F2 scenario: the same enrolled Alice appears on the FRONT camera on day 1 and the GARAGE camera on day 2, so the graph holds a visits_place edge to BOTH devices from one identity. The Detective is asked to trace Alice's movements across cameras; it should consult a graph/journey tool and name BOTH cameras. Proves: the loop uses the relationship graph and narrates a cross-camera journey grounded in the fused identity (the join the raw pipeline never makes). STAGING-only. Media shared with graph_cross_camera_fusion, regenerable via local_dev/fetch_eval_clips.sh.
